name: Genobi teaser
summary: Two minutes of the studio in use cut to the owner's track Trailer-Genobi at 135 BPM: studio footage driven in a browser, the owner's generations on the drops, Transitions.dev titles and reveals run unchanged, and Genobi recipes for the pointer, focus boxes, camera moves and wipes. Nothing is generated. Three versions: the first cut, the owner's two rounds of corrections, and creatures instead of realism.

versions.title: The first cut
versions.summary: The second mix template: nine silent studio recordings and the owner's generations cut to the whole track, with the construction end card (MADE WITH / GENOBI) and the HUD saying what the studio did rather than where clips came from.
changes: Footage recorded by scripts/capture-genobi-teaser.mjs, nothing spent
Seven new recipes: gen-title, gen-image, gen-status, ui-zoom, ui-cursor, ui-focus, signal-wipe
Review notes applied: the HUD claims match the clips; Scrolls kept to four beats; every UI beat zooms onto a readable detail

versions.title: Sharper, on the lyric, with a taste layer
versions.summary: The owner's round-2 and round-3 corrections: rendered at 1920 × 1080 from the same takes re-recorded at 3840 × 2160, camera controls and the ComfyUI workflow, the shader beat on the lyric with Paper's dithering shader then a Space.js effect, lyric-synced beats after it, and a TASTE LAYER of the libraries Genobi ships.
changes: 1920 × 1080 from 4K re-recordings of the same scripted takes; slice moves sample the 4K source; no AI upscale
0:27 CAMERA CONTROLS over Camera's BFL camera terms
0:36 ★ THREE.JS into the owner's ComfyUI workflow, with no text over the ComfyUI shot
About 1:16–1:18: Paper's dithering shader, then a Space.js effect, when the vocal sings "shaders, transitions"
Beats after it follow the lyric: transitions, references with credit, licences, run locally, save, reuse
TASTE LAYER on black, ANDREW ZELLINGER first
Less repetition: 124 of 128 layers; the owner's own upscaled clips swapped in as files

versions.title: Creatures, not realism
versions.summary: The owner's look for the teaser and the Dimensions mix: creatures and anime across the board. His upscaled MiniMax H3 creature clips replace the motorbike, the forest trees and the neon bloom on the same beats, the rendered Dimensions mix beat plays his upscaled render, and every focus box's label reads at least 1.3 s .
changes: Motorbike (0:32) → a vine creature, built by the gen-image reveal from its own frame; the status names MiniMax H3
Neon bloom (0:14) and four final-drop shots → the owner's upscaled MiniMax H3 creature clips
Toy creatures (0:12, 0:43, final drop) → creature clips, so the generated footage is MiniMax H3 and one FLUX 3 run, and the card names both
Forest trees (final drop) → a creature among orbs
Every focus box's label reads at least 1.3 s, fully typed and uncovered : focus-66 draws in 0.1 s and the reveal card starts a beat later (beat 70)
The Dimensions mix beat (0:51) plays the owner's upscaled render; the gallery, Camera and Dual Swords takes are recorded again so the interface shows the upscaled media
Every UI take recorded again at 3840 × 2160, CRF 18, from the branch being cut, with the same choreography and pace (the owner's capture-quality rule)
The ComfyUI take re-encoded once from the owner's original recording
About 1:18: Space.js and the Transitions.dev reveal share one flower creature, so no character switches before the TASTE LAYER; the layer carries the owner's credit line on a steady background
Opening forest guardian built from the 1918 × 820 FLUX start image; creature clips re-encoded near-lossless from the 4K and 5K upscales
0:19–0:24: the Editor timeline (a clip moved, its edge trimmed, the cut tool, Regenerate opened, nothing sent) in place of the Camera families take, which still plays at 200–210
Project media 146.5 MiB, under the Editor's 150 MiB: edits save in the Editor

checkpoints.summary: Version 1 shipped as the second mix template : 2,869 frames at 24 fps, 127 layers, rendered by Render MP4 for the gallery card.

Version 2 merged : the round-2 and round-3 corrections, rendered end to end with Render MP4 at 1920 × 1080 (2,869 frames). Recorded here from the merge commit; v1's replaced footage archived so v1 still opens.

Version 3: creatures for the bike, trees and toys, every UI take recorded again at 3840 × 2160, the Editor timeline at 0:19, one creature through the shader beat, a 24 Mb/s master; project media 146.5 MiB, so the Editor saves edits.
